edit.statement: The collapse of AT&T's long-distance telephone network on 15 January 1990 was caused by a bug in newly installed software on its 4ESS switches.

notes: Real: AT&T traced the 15 January 1990 collapse to a fault in new software loaded into its 4ESS switches in December 1989 (AT&T statement; 'All Circuits are Busy Now', Cal Poly; RISKS Digest). It is an obscure incident that most models are unlikely to hold.
